ucs.title: [LLM] Salt Typhoon (FamousSparrow / Earth Estries) — SparrowDoor / Crowdoor DLL search-order hijack via AV-vendor signed loader
ucs.description: Hunts the FamousSparrow/Crowdoor sideload chain Salt Typhoon has used against telcos and hospitality targets: a legitimately signed third-party utility (K7 Computing, Indigo Office, ASUS LiveUpdate, Avast, Norton) is dropped into a writable user/world path and is used to LoadLibrary an attacker-supplied DLL (the SparrowDoor/Crowdoor/HemiGate stager). Pairs the execution of the signed loader from an anomalous path with an unsigned/non-Microsoft DLL load from the same directory — the exact ESET/Trend Micro IOC pattern.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_path IN ("*\\ProgramData\\*", "*\\AppData\\*", "*\\Users\\Public\\*", "*\\PerfLogs\\*", "*\\Windows\\Temp\\*", "*\\Tasks\\*")) AND (Processes.process_company IN ("K7 Computing*", "Indigo*", "ASUSTeK*", "Symantec*", "NortonLifeLock*", "AVAST*", "Bitdefender*", "Trend Micro*", "ESET*", "Sophos*", "Kaspersky*")) AND NOT (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("msiexec.exe", "setup.exe", "explorer.exe", "OfficeClickToRun.exe")) by host Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process_path Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process Processes.process_hash Processes.process_id | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | join type=inner host process_id [| tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name="*.dll") AND (Filesystem.file_path IN ("*\\ProgramData\\*", "*\\AppData\\*", "*\\Users\\Public\\*", "*\\PerfLogs\\*")) by host Filesystem.process_id Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.file_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | rename process_id as process_id] | where process_path!="" | table firstTime lastTime host user process_name process_path parent_process_name process_hash file_name file_path file_hash
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let TrustedVendors = dynamic(["K7 Computing Pvt Ltd","Indigo Software","Indigo Networks","ASUSTeK COMPUTER INC.","Symantec Corporation","NortonLifeLock Inc.","AVAST Software","Bitdefender","Trend Micro Inc.","ESET, spol. s r.o.","Sophos Limited","Kaspersky Lab"]);
let AbusablePaths = dynamic([@"\ProgramData\",@"\AppData\",@"\Users\Public\",@"\PerfLogs\",@"\Windows\Temp\",@"\$Recycle.Bin\"]);
let SideloadHosts =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName in (TrustedVendors)
    | where FolderPath has_any (AbusablePaths)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("msiexec.exe","setup.exe","explorer.exe","officeclicktorun.exe","trustedinstaller.exe")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, LoaderProcessId = ProcessId,
              LoaderFileName = FileName, LoaderFolderPath = FolderPath,
              LoaderSHA256 = SHA256, LoaderCompany = ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName,
              LoaderCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              ParentName = InitiatingProcessFileName, ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
DeviceImageLoadEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where FileName endswith ".dll"
| where FolderPath has_any (AbusablePaths)
| where InitiatingProcessVersionInfoCompanyName in (TrustedVendors)
| join kind=inner SideloadHosts on DeviceId, $left.InitiatingProcessId == $right.LoaderProcessId
| where tolower(FolderPath) == tolower(LoaderFolderPath)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          LoaderFileName, LoaderFolderPath, LoaderSHA256, LoaderCompany,
          SideloadedDll = FileName, SideloadedDllPath = FolderPath, SideloadedDllSHA256 = SHA256,
          ParentName, ParentCmd, LoaderCmd
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let TrustedVendors = dynamic(["K7 Computing Pvt Ltd","Indigo Software","ASUSTeK COMPUTER INC.","Symantec Corporation","NortonLifeLock Inc.","AVAST Software","Bitdefender","Trend Micro Inc.","ESET, spol. s r.o.","Sophos Limited","Kaspersky Lab"]);
let AbusablePaths = dynamic([@"\ProgramData\",@"\AppData\",@"\Users\Public\",@"\PerfLogs\",@"\Windows\Temp\"]);
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventType == "ProcessCreated"
| where ActingProcessFileCompany in (TrustedVendors)
| where ActingProcessCommandLine has_any (AbusablePaths)
   or TargetProcessCommandLine has_any (AbusablePaths)
| where ParentProcessName !in~ ("msiexec.exe","setup.exe","explorer.exe","OfficeClickToRun.exe","TrustedInstaller.exe")
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          LoaderProcess = ActingProcessName, LoaderCompany = ActingProcessFileCompany,
          LoaderCmd = ActingProcessCommandLine, LoaderPid = ActingProcessId,
          ParentName = ParentProcessName, ParentCmd = ParentProcessCommandLine,
          TargetProcess = TargetProcessName, TargetCmd = TargetProcessCommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc

ucs.title: [LLM] Salt Typhoon (GhostEmperor) — Demodex kernel rootkit loader: anomalous kernel-driver service registration outside System32\drivers
ucs.description: Hunts the Demodex kernel rootkit loader chain used by GhostEmperor (a Salt Typhoon cluster Kaspersky originally tracked against SE Asian telcos, since seen against US carriers). Demodex stages a kernel driver via a freshly created Service registry hive entry whose ImagePath points at a .sys file outside the standard driver directory, often dropped to %TEMP%, %ProgramData% or a randomly-named subdir of %SystemRoot%. Catches the registry write before the driver is loaded.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Registry where (Registry.registry_path="*\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\*\\ImagePath" OR Registry.registry_path="*\\SYSTEM\\ControlSet001\\Services\\*\\ImagePath") AND (Registry.registry_value_data="*.sys*") AND NOT (Registry.registry_value_data IN ("*\\System32\\drivers\\*", "*\\System32\\DriverStore\\*", "*\\SystemRoot\\System32\\drivers\\*", "*\\??\\C:\\Windows\\System32\\drivers\\*", "\\SystemRoot\\System32\\drivers\\*")) by host Registry.user Registry.registry_path Registry.registry_value_name Registry.registry_value_data Registry.process_guid Registry.process_id | `drop_dm_object_name(Registry)` | join type=outer host process_id [| tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes by host Processes.process_id Processes.process_name Processes.process_path Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name Processes.user | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`] | where NOT match(user, "(?i)^(SYSTEM|LOCAL SERVICE|NETWORK SERVICE|.*\$)$") OR match(process_name, "(?i)^(powershell|pwsh|cmd|rundll32|regsvr32|wscript|cscript|mshta)\.exe$") | table firstTime lastTime host user process_name process_path parent_process_name registry_path registry_value_data
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 30d;
DeviceRegistryEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where ActionType in ("RegistryValueSet","RegistryKeyCreated")
| where RegistryKey matches regex @"(?i)\\SYSTEM\\(CurrentControlSet|ControlSet\d{3})\\Services\\[^\\]+$"
   or RegistryValueName =~ "ImagePath"
| where RegistryValueData has ".sys"
| where RegistryValueData !contains @"\System32\drivers\"
| where RegistryValueData !contains @"\System32\DriverStore\"
| where RegistryValueData !contains @"\SystemRoot\System32\drivers\"
| where RegistryValueData !contains @"\Windows\WinSxS\"
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("msiexec.exe","trustedinstaller.exe","drvinst.exe","setup.exe","wusa.exe")
| extend ServiceName = extract(@"Services\\([^\\]+)", 1, RegistryKey)
| extend ServiceNameLooksRandom = ServiceName matches regex @"^[a-zA-Z0-9]{6,16}$" and ServiceName matches regex @"[a-z]" and ServiceName matches regex @"[A-Z0-9]"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, ServiceName, ServiceNameLooksRandom,
          DriverImagePath = RegistryValueData,
          RegistryKey, RegistryValueName,
          ActorUser = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          ActorProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ActorCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ActorParent = InitiatingProcessParentFileName
| join kind=leftouter (
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName endswith ".sys"
    | project DeviceName, DriverSHA256 = SHA256, DriverFolderPath = FolderPath, DriverFileName = FileName, DroppedBy = InitiatingProcessFileName, DroppedByCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine
) on DeviceName
| where DriverImagePath contains DriverFileName or isempty(DriverFileName)
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 30d;
ImRegistryEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventType in ("RegistryValueSet","RegistryKeyCreated")
| where RegistryKey matches regex @"(?i)\\SYSTEM\\(CurrentControlSet|ControlSet\d{3})\\Services\\[^\\]+$"
| where RegistryValue =~ "ImagePath"
| where RegistryValueData has ".sys"
| where RegistryValueData !contains @"\System32\drivers\"
| where RegistryValueData !contains @"\System32\DriverStore\"
| where RegistryValueData !contains @"\SystemRoot\System32\drivers\"
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| where ActingProcessName !in~ ("msiexec.exe","TrustedInstaller.exe","drvinst.exe","setup.exe","wusa.exe")
| extend ServiceName = extract(@"Services\\([^\\]+)", 1, RegistryKey)
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ServiceName,
          DriverImagePath = RegistryValueData,
          RegistryKey,
          ActorUsername, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc

title: Salt Typhoon GhostEmperor Demodex Kernel Driver Service Registration Outside System32\drivers
id: 9b1a6f4c-2d8e-4e7a-b034-salttyphoon02
status: experimental
description: Detects the Demodex (GhostEmperor) kernel rootkit loader pattern - registration of a kernel driver service whose ImagePath points to a .sys file outside the standard System32\drivers location. Associated with Salt Typhoon / Earth Estries / GhostEmperor.
references:
  - https://securelist.com/ghostemperor-from-proxylogon-to-kernel-mode/104407/
  - https://www.trendmicro.com/en_us/research/24/k/earth-estries.html
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/21
tags:
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1014
  - attack.t1547.001
  - attack.g1045
logsource:
  category: registry_set
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetObject|contains:
      - '\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\'
      - '\SYSTEM\ControlSet001\Services\'
    TargetObject|endswith: '\ImagePath'
    Details|contains: '.sys'
  filter_paths:
    Details|contains:
      - '\System32\drivers\'
      - '\System32\DriverStore\'
      - '\SystemRoot\System32\drivers\'
      - '\Windows\WinSxS\'
  filter_installers:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\msiexec.exe'
      - '\TrustedInstaller.exe'
      - '\drvinst.exe'
      - '\setup.exe'
      - '\wusa.exe'
  condition: selection and not filter_paths and not filter_installers
falsepositives:
  - Some third-party EDR / AV vendors install drivers under \Program Files\ rather than \System32\drivers\ (allow-list per vendor)
  - VPN clients that register kernel-mode TUN/TAP drivers from their install directory
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:13 @TargetObject:(*\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\*\\ImagePath OR *\\SYSTEM\\ControlSet001\\Services\\*\\ImagePath) @Details:*.sys* -@Details:(*\\System32\\drivers\\* OR *\\system32\\drivers\\* OR *\\System32\\DriverStore\\* OR *\\SystemRoot\\System32\\drivers\\* OR *\\Windows\\WinSxS\\*) -@Image:(*\\msiexec.exe OR *\\MsiExec.exe OR *\\TrustedInstaller.exe OR *\\drvinst.exe OR *\\setup.exe OR *\\wusa.exe)
